programs.title: The 90-Day Prostate Recovery Program
programs.subtitle: Rebuild bladder control, pelvic-floor timing, and confidence after prostate surgery.

weeks.themeSubtitle: Start with gentle breath, release, and control before adding more strength.

days.title: Lift and Release
days.intention: Reconnect your breath and pelvic floor with a gentle lift, then let the muscles release fully. Keep the effort gentle and stop if your surgical team has not cleared pelvic-floor exercise.

days.title: Build the Support Team
days.intention: Train your hips and deep abdominal muscles to share the work around your bladder. Keep the effort gentle and stop if your surgical team has not cleared pelvic-floor exercise.

days.title: Exhale Before Effort
days.intention: Breathe out just before effort and add a light pelvic-floor lift to manage pressure. Keep the effort gentle and stop if your surgical team has not cleared pelvic-floor exercise.

days.title: Make Control Last
days.intention: Practice steady pelvic-floor control while keeping your jaw, belly, and breath relaxed. Keep the effort gentle and stop if your surgical team has not cleared pelvic-floor exercise.

days.title: Take Control Upright
days.intention: Bring your timing into standing, walking, steps, and the daily moments when leaks can happen. Keep the effort gentle and stop if your surgical team has not cleared pelvic-floor exercise.

days.title: Ready for Real Life
days.intention: Add useful strength around the pelvis without gripping all day. Keep the effort gentle and stop if your surgical team has not cleared pelvic-floor exercise.

days.title: Recovery Reset
days.intention: Use slower movement and easy breathing so your body can absorb the week's work. Keep the effort gentle and stop if your surgical team has not cleared pelvic-floor exercise.
